name: synthetic-create-constructor-transfer
description: SYNTHETIC: factory CREATEs a token whose constructor emits Transfer(alice->bob); the CREATE frame is a msg.sender boundary (creator = factory != alice) and its bytecode input has no recognized selector -> other. The root CALL deliberately carries transferFrom-shaped calldata: if the CREATE boundary were ignored this would misclassify as approved

name: synthetic-duplicates-same-caller
description: SYNTHETIC: a token-call frame emits two byte-identical Transfer logs (the same contract pulling the same amount twice) — both candidate frames classify identically, so the agreement collapse attributes both rows even though duplicates are never paired with specific frames

name: synthetic-eip3009-relayed
description: SYNTHETIC: relayer submits token.transferWithAuthorization (EIP-3009, selector 0xe3ee160e) moving alice's tokens on a signed authorization; tx.from is the relayer, not alice -> signature_authorized with no spender

name: synthetic-log-not-in-trace
description: SYNTHETIC: the stored Transfer log does not appear anywhere in the trace (e.g. truncated or mismatched trace) -> unknown with the not-found error

expected.error: transfer log not found in trace

name: synthetic-multicall-delegatecall-self
description: SYNTHETIC: marketplace CALLs an NFT-manager token with multicall (0xac9650d8) which DELEGATECALLs itself with transferFrom calldata, inside which the ERC-721 Transfer is emitted; the recognized selector nearest the emission wins -> approved with spender = marketplace, selector 0x23b872dd

name: synthetic-permit2-batch-allowance-transfer
description: SYNTHETIC: a Permit2 instance entered through the BATCH AllowanceTransfer transferFrom selector where the second tuple in the array corroborates the emitted Transfer log (the first tuple is an unrelated transfer), exercising the batch calldata decode path

name: synthetic-permit2-clone-allowance-transfer
description: SYNTHETIC: a NON-canonical Permit2 instance (deployed at an arbitrary address) is entered through the single AllowanceTransfer transferFrom selector with arguments matching the emitted Transfer log, so the structural detection attributes the inner spender and records the clone as permit2Address — no hardcoded canonical address involved

name: synthetic-permit2-selector-collision
description: SYNTHETIC: an unrelated contract is coincidentally entered through a function sharing the AllowanceTransfer transferFrom selector, but the decoded arguments do NOT corroborate the emitted Transfer log (different token address), so no inner-spender attribution happens and the spender stays the token-level msg.sender

name: synthetic-permit2-signature-transfer
description: SYNTHETIC: Permit2 SignatureTransfer (permitTransferFrom, selector 0x30f28b7a) — a filler submits the owner's one-shot signed authorization; Permit2 calls token.transferFrom. Unlike AllowanceTransfer, the filler holds no permit-granted allowance and appears in no approval event, so the spender stays Permit2 itself (matching the owner's ERC-20 approval to Permit2) and permit2Address stays unset.

name: synthetic-seaport-conduit-nft
description: SYNTHETIC: Seaport-style fill where buyer CALLs seaport, seaport CALLs its conduit, and the conduit CALLs token.transferFrom pulling the seller's ERC-721 (4-topic Transfer with tokenId) -> approved with spender = conduit

name: real-rootstock-ancestor-propagated-logs
description: REAL Rootstock tx 0x6a5cce06933cecb6ecf338785b17debc94069961233be78f932f4ddd3642a951: the Rootstock tracer propagates every subcall log into all ancestor frames (each receipt log appears once per ancestor level in the trace), which used to produce false ambiguous-duplicate verdicts; the ancestor-copy dedup must attribute all three transfers via their deepest (emitting) frames

name: real-gnosis-mislabeled-reverted-frame
description: REAL Gnosis tx 0x2c65af2e0f37f7ebb8a3dd16ea4fa2df1aec2f001f8db7d28f351e71569c93c4: the backend labels a DELEGATECALL frame "execution reverted" even though its Transfer log is in the receipt (a caught child revert bubbled into the parent label); the receipt-verified log must still be attributed via the reverted-marked frame since no clean frame carries it
